prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Professional Japanese 2D visual-novel PRODUCTION DETAIL SHEET on a uniform warm very pale grey OPAQUE background. Match Image 1 exactly for colors, shapes and simplified low-noise cel rendering. Clean dark line, large flat colors, one hard shadow per material. Show separate isolated orthographic detail drawings with generous spacing; no full-body character, invisible mannequin, scenery or effects. NO text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, logos or watermarks.
DETAILS: horn side/front and tail tip, armor main plates and mantle attachment, spear full side/front and spearhead/tassel enlargement.
EXACT RULES: One slim spear, overall length 190 cm, straight black shaft, simple gold-edged red leaf-shaped spearhead and ONE short crimson tassel beneath blade. Tail has plain smooth segments and one dark red leaf-shaped tip; not a weapon carried in hand.
HARD LOCKS: 角2尾1; 黑角金尖; 翼形披肩2片非肉翅; 长枪1杆; 枪缨1束. Every physical object appears once; front/back/side or open/closed views are alternate views of the same item. No extra decorative filler.
